Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente.

Somos uma instituição que tem a tradição e inovação como pilares. A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino e pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.

A instituição secular, quesempre esteve a serviço do bem da população baiana , tem sua gestão orientada estrategicamente para que colaboradores e voluntários sigam a mesma base filosófica e, com isso, a sociedade possa compreender a personalidade da entidade.

  • Dentre outros.

Seja bem-vindo (a) ao Portal de Carreiras da Santa Casa da Bahia!

Ficamos felizes pelo seu interesse em participar da nossa equipe de colaboradores, que já soma aproximadamente 5.500 funcionários.

Antes de sabermos mais sobre suas características profissionais, convidamos você a conhecer um pouco da história da Santa Casa da

Bahia, instituição filantrópica que se propõe ao objetivo de ajudar aos mais necessitados.

Foi no ano de 1549, quando Tomé de Sousa ocupava o posto de governador-geral do Brasil, que foi construída uma casa de taipa e palha, no Centro Histórico de Salvador, que por cerca de 200 anos abrigou o Hospital de Caridade, primeiro hospital do Estado da Bahia, sendo o único a prestar assistência aos baianos na época.

Somente em 30 de julho de 1893 foi construído o Hospital Santa Izabel (HSI), no bairro de Nazaré, em Salvador, desativando a antiga

unidade de saúde que funcionava no Pelourinho. O prédio do primeiro hospital passou a ser a sede administrativa da Santa Casa da Bahia e, em 2006, se tornou o Museu da Misericórdia.

A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de

serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino, pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.

title: Technical Program Manager II
description:
About us

WEX is a global commerce platform that helps businesses solve operational complexities like employee benefits, managing and mobilizing fleets, and streamlining payments.

With over 5,500 employees, we work with large and small companies in more than 200 countries and territories, and can tailor our services to meet the unique needs of their businesses.

A Technical Program Manager is a key partner to the Technology leaders and their Digital counterparts in driving and assisting successful delivery of technology outcomes. You will be responsible for driving delivery on projects and initiatives within one or more Technology areas.

As a TPM II at WEX, you will focus on enabling execution, coordinating across technology teams, tracking project progress, and ensuring delivery against defined plans. You will play a key role partnering with Technology leaders and other teams to drive delivery of initiatives that support more efficient ways of working for WEX's employees, as part of the Employee Technical Services team's mission. Your primary focus will be on managing the execution of projects centered on internal hardware, tooling and software that supports a more efficient and delightful employee experience. You will coordinate and lead efforts across cross-functional teams to plan, execute, and deliver software and tools that enable our employees to succeed in their roles, using efficient cutting‑edge technologies. You will also work closely with technical partners to execute and enable migrations and consolidations of internal tooling solutions.

The Technical Program Management Office (TPMO) is a strategic function of the Technology Innovation & Strategic Operations (TISO) department within WEX. Our mission is to accelerate WEX’s product innovation velocity by optimizing how we deliver technology. We accelerate technology delivery at WEX by optimizing program execution across all technology domains.

How you’ll make an impact

Technical Fluency

  • Manage the execution of internal tooling initiatives and platform migration / consolidation projects, including improvements to development workflows, automation systems, and application / service modernization.
  • Collaborate with application architects, platform engineers, data specialists, and internal tooling teams to document project scope, milestones, and success criteria.
  • Develop detailed work breakdown structures, execution plans, and project roadmaps for tooling enhancements, system consolidation efforts, and cross‑platform migrations.
  • Oversee project and sub‑initiative execution that streamlines internal platforms, standardizes tooling across teams, and improves operational efficiency, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Partner with platform and tooling engineering teams to ensure seamless migration, deployment, and operational readiness of internal systems and shared services.
  • Coordinate efforts across engineering and security teams to modernize shared tools, integrate authentication and authorization systems, and ensure internal services meet compliance and governance requirements.
  • Manage dependencies related to application routing, service integrations, environment configurations, and monitoring / logging toolchains to support reliable and consistent internal operations.

Program Planning / Continuous Planning: Based on Product and Technology leadership direction and priorities, facilitate ongoing planning sessions and huddles to ensure continuous alignment with business goals within and across your portfolio. This will require close cross‑functional partnership with technology team leaders, solution architects, and product partners. Ensure alignment of program increments with overall business goals and priorities. Encourage adaptive planning within the project team to respond to changing delivery and project requirements.

Program Management

Own and drive end‑to‑end technical implementation projects and workstreams as assigned. You’ll detailed work breakdowns, milestones, risks, and deliverables for key project initiatives, and execute project plans in partnership with engineering leadership. On an ongoing basis, support and execute against the team’s enhancement roadmap for systems, tools, and processes.

Execution Management

In support of the Tech Lead, monitor progress and recommend necessary adjustments to surface risks of program execution to key stakeholders in a targeted and timely way, with the goal of course correction. Facilitate these course corrections, as needed.

Stakeholder and Change Management

Engage with stakeholders — Technology, Product, Solution Architecture, among others — to ensure visibility, provide updates, and address concerns. Facilitate communication between teams, ensuring transparency and alignment. Provide clear, consistent, and timely information flow and reports out on status. Work collaboratively at project and stakeholder levels to facilitate and enable change to support new ways of working and modern technology architectures.

Risk Management

Identify technical risks related to implementation considerations for assigned projects. Assist in developing mitigation strategies with technical partners.

Dependency Management

Identify, document, and track dependencies within the scope of your projects and across adjacent teams. Proactively coordinate with stakeholders to ensure dependencies are clearly understood and addressed.

Tooling and Data Hygiene

Accordingly, ensure the use of standard project management tools — ideally within the Atlassian suite — and maintain high standards of data hygiene to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity. Support accurate and transparent reporting and on‑target capitalization within the organization through data stewardship.

Delivery and Outcome Tracking

Track project performance against the committed plan and goals. Use data and metrics to support decision‑making and continuous improvement at the project level.

Experience you’ll bring

Relevant experience in technical program management managing projects or complex sub‑initiatives focused on internal tooling and capabilities. An ideal candidate has a blend of technical acumen and strong project management skills to drive execution within cross‑functional initiatives. They are comfortable working in ambiguous or fast‑paced environments and excel at executing detailed project plans. They are passionate about implementing solutions and communicating effectively with project and mid‑level stakeholders.

Technical Skills

  • Experience managing application and service migrations, such as consolidating services into shared platforms, migrating legacy applications to modern frameworks, or transitioning internal systems across environments.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems and microservice architectures, including service discovery, API gateways, internal routing, and inter‑service communication patterns.
  • Understanding of database and data platform migrations, including schema evolution, data validation, ETL workflow transitions, and consolidation across environments or platforms.
  • Knowledge of security and compliance requirements, including identity integration (SSO / SAML / OIDC), role‑based access control, audit logging, and governance for internal tools.
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing platforms and services (AWS, Azure, GCP), including infrastructure‑as‑code and cloud security best practices.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and project management tools.

Leadership and Communication

  • Demonstrated ability to take initiative and execute within a project team.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross‑functional teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.

Problem‑Solving

Ability to identify potential risks and issues at the project level and proactively support their mitigation or resolution in partnership with technology leadership. Analytical mindset with strong execution capabilities.

Desired qualifications & experiences

  • Bachelor’s Degree.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, Agile Certified Practitioner).
  • Previous experience in FinTech or highly regulated environments.

title: Social Media Marketing Specialist | Remote | Us B2B Saas Startup In Real Estate Ops
description:
We connect talented tech professionals in Latin America and Canada with remote career opportunities at innovative startups worldwide. We specialize in finding roles that align with your skills, experience, and career goals. Our personalized approach ensures you're matched with companies that value your contributions and offer opportunities for growth. Whether you're a software engineer, designer, marketer, or other tech professional, we're here to help you take the next step in your career.

Company Overview

Our client is a profitable SaaS company that has supported property managers for over a decade. With more than 20,000 active users and 100M+ inspection photos processed, the platform helps customers—from single landlords to large firms—save time and reduce stress with mobile inspections, automated reports, and AI‑powered tools. The team of ~20 people is fully distributed and focused on steady growth and long‑term value.

Your Role

You’ll plan, create, and publish content that shows what property managers deal with daily—and how the product solves those exact problems. Most work centers on short videos, walkthroughs, carousels, and posts for Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, and email, using real examples from the field, support, product updates, and customer inputs.

You’ll :

  • Produce short videos, screen recordings, carousels, and posts that show when a feature matters and why
  • Use real inputs (customer stories, field photos, support themes, product updates) to create concrete examples
  • Adapt one idea into multiple formats across social, YouTube Shorts, email, and occasional blog posts
  • Write clear captions and short copy that connect real property‑management problems to the product
  • Maintain consistent visual style and messaging across channels
  • Review performance metrics (views, watch time, clicks, comments) and refine topics
  • Add each new asset to an internal library for reuse across teams

You Bring :

  • Ability to explain complex features simply and accurately
  • Experience creating short‑form digital content (video or social posts)
  • Comfort recording screen captures and doing basic video edits (cuts, captions)
  • Ability to follow a content plan and publish consistently each week
  • Curiosity to learn how property managers work and what problems they face
  • Good organization and ownership of your weekly tasks
  • Comfortable working most of your day within U.S. business hours

Bonus Points :

  • Experience making how‑to content, tutorials, or simple walkthroughs
  • Background in property management, real estate, operations, or fieldwork
  • Experience writing short marketing copy, email snippets, or simple explainers
  • Familiarity with Canva or Figma (or willingness to learn quickly)
  • Previous work in SaaS, B2B tools, or workflow products

What’s Offered :

  • Fully remote contractor role (~40 hrs / week)
  • 10–17 USD per hour (~$2,000–3,000 / month)
  • Paid time off, coordinated with campaign cycles
  • Lean, collaborative team with direct input to Marketing Director
  • Long‑term stability with a profitable, steadily growing SaaS company
  • Opportunity to expand into channel ownership and campaign planning

Interview Process :

1️⃣ Online Tests – Short Wingfinder assessment and typing test

2️⃣ Screening Call – Conversation with the recruiter about your background and interest in the role

3️⃣ Marketing Challenge – Create a short social / video post and repurpose it into blog or email copy, based on real product inputs

4️⃣ Interview with Marketing Director – Deep dive on your content process, examples, and how you’d approach priorities

5️⃣ Final Interview with CEO – Discussion about company fit, expectations, and long‑term collaboration

Most candidates move through the process in about 1–2 weeks .

With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. As part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

What is the role?

This is a Senior Customer Success Analyst role for someone who operates comfortably without a fixed scope, moves fluidly between strategy and execution, and takes ownership not just of relationships, but of outcomes.

At Teachable, creators are entrepreneurs who build, market, and scale digital education businesses, using our platform as their core operating system. You will own a portfolio of high-potential creators and drive retention, growth, and expansion by acting as a strategic and tactical advisor. This role goes beyond relationship management : you will diagnose business challenges, form a point of view, and deliver clear, actionable recommendations that help creators scale their businesses through product adoption, marketing, and growth strategies.

As our Customer Success model continues to evolve, the scope and engagement approach of your portfolio may change over time. This role is well-suited for someone who is comfortable operating in this context and adjusting priorities thoughtfully as the team scales.

In this role you’ll :

  • Own and manage a portfolio of high-potential creators, where portfolio size, composition, and engagement approach may evolve over time as our Customer Success model continues to take shape.
  • Be accountable for retention and growth outcomes across your portfolio by turning goals into concrete success plans, defining what “good” looks like for each account, and influencing customer decisions through clear recommendations, follow-ups, and next steps.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by diagnosing business problems, forming a point of view, and recommending specific actions related to sales, marketing, monetization, and platform usage. This role requires comfort moving from strategy to tactics (including discussing offers, funnels, launches, pricing, and distribution) and clearly articulating what the customer should do next.

title: Technical Project Manager | Startup Transforming legal tech with AI Latam
description:
We connect talented tech professionals in Latin America and Canada with remote career opportunities at innovative startups worldwide. We specialize in finding roles that align with your skills, experience, and career goals. Our personalized approach ensures you're matched with companies that value your contributions and offer opportunities for growth. Whether you're a software engineer, designer, marketer, or other tech professional, we're here to help you take the next step in your career.

About Us

Our partner is revolutionizing legal technology with AI-driven tools that enhance efficiency and accessibility for legal professionals. We're undertaking high-impact technology transformation, partnering with a high-volume immigration law firm to optimize workflows and streamline processes. Join us in building the future of legal tech, where impactful innovation meets user-centric design.

Role Overview

The Technical Project Manager will establish operational excellence across our engineering organization, transforming how we plan, track, and deliver software. As we scale rapidly, our project management infrastructure needs to evolve from startup chaos to disciplined execution without sacrificing velocity. You'll work directly with the Senior Engineering Manager and engineering leads to bring structure to Linear, implement sustainable task management practices, establish reliable metrics, and create visibility that enables data‑driven decision making. This role requires both technical credibility to earn engineers' respect and the assertiveness to enforce standards that keep us shipping predictably.

Key Responsibilities

  • Linear Ownership : Serve as the primary owner of our Linear workspace, ensuring it accurately reflects reality at all times. Audit existing tasks, establish hygiene standards, and maintain the system as our single source of truth for all engineering work.
  • Task Breakdown Facilitation : Work with engineering leads to decompose large epics into properly scoped, shippable work items. Establish standards for task sizing (2-5 day completions) and ensure consistent application across teams.
  • Metrics and Reporting : Design and maintain engineering health metrics including cycle time, lead time, PR age, task completion rates, and delivery predictability. Build dashboards that provide actionable insights to leadership without overwhelming engineers.
  • Process Implementation : Establish and enforce standards for task creation, updates, and closure. Create documentation, run training sessions, and ensure team-wide adoption of best practices.
  • Project Execution : Track projects from conception through delivery, identifying blockers early and coordinating across backend, frontend, and AI engineering teams to ensure timely completion.
  • Planning Facilitation : Run sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives with engineering teams. Ensure planning sessions are efficient, focused, and result in actionable, well‑defined work.
  • Cross‑Team Coordination : Manage dependencies between teams, ensuring visibility and proper sequencing of work. Facilitate communication between engineering, product, and infrastructure teams.
  • Stakeholder Communication : Translate engineering progress to non‑technical stakeholders, providing clear project status updates and timeline visibility without creating reporting overhead for engineers.

Technical Proficiency

Must be proficient in several of the following :

  • Project Management Tools : Expert‑level proficiency with Linear, including projects, cycles, views, automation, and API integration. 2+ years of hands‑on experience required.
  • Agile Methodologies : Deep understanding of agile / scrum practices, sprint planning, backlog grooming, estimation techniques, and retrospective facilitation.
  • Engineering Metrics : Familiarity with DORA metrics, cycle time, lead time, throughput, and other engineering productivity indicators. Ability to design meaningful dashboards.
  • Technical Context : Sufficient technical depth to understand software architecture, API design, database schemas, CI / CD pipelines, and infrastructure concepts. You don't need to code but must understand what's complex and why.
  • Development Workflows : Understanding of Git workflows, PR processes, code review practices, testing strategies, and deployment pipelines.
  • Documentation Systems : Experience with documentation tools (Notion, Confluence) and establishing documentation standards for technical teams.
  • Tech Stack Familiarity : Bonus points for understanding Django / Python backends, React frontends, AWS infrastructure, or AI / ML project workflows.

Qualifications

  • Linear Expertise : 1+ years of hands‑on experience managing engineering projects in Linear in a technical environment. You know the tool cold and can configure it to support complex workflows.
  • Startup Experience : 2+ years in fast‑moving startup environments, demonstrating ability to balance process with velocity and build systems from scratch.
  • Technical Credibility : Background that gives you credibility with senior engineers, whether through previous engineering roles, CS degree, technical project management, or deep immersion in technical environments.
  • Process Transformation : Proven track record of inheriting messy project management situations and transforming them into well‑functioning systems. You've built or significantly improved PM processes, not just maintained existing ones.
  • Execution Focus : Strong delivery track record with measurable improvements in engineering productivity, predictability, or process efficiency.
  • Communication Skills : Excellent written and verbal communication, able to translate between technical and non‑technical stakeholders clearly and concisely.
  • Assertiveness and Influence : Ability to enforce standards and push back on poor practices while maintaining positive relationships. You can be firm about process without being a bureaucrat.
  • Analytical Mindset : Data‑driven approach to problem‑solving, comfortable with metrics, analytics, and using quantitative evidence to drive decisions.

Core Values and Culture

Our partneris built on a foundation of shared principles that guide our work and interactions. We seek team members who embody and contribute to these values :

  • User‑Centric Perspective : Build with empathy, ensuring every feature enhances our users' experience and addresses their needs.
  • Radical Transparency : Promote open communication and information sharing to make the best decisions and foster trust.
  • Purpose‑Driven Work : Ensure each task aligns with our mission to deliver meaningful, innovative solutions.
  • Single Responsible Individual : Every team member takes ownership, driving tasks to completion with accountability.
  • Extreme Ownership : Learn and grow from challenges, continuously refining our work and striving for excellence.
  • Singular Focus : Dedicate attention to core objectives, eliminating distractions to achieve impactful results.
  • Documentation Excellence : Maintain clear and thorough documentation to enhance collaboration and continuity.
  • Data‑Informed Decisions : Use data to guide priorities, ensuring our work delivers value to our users.
  • Compassionate Communication : Foster empathy and respect in dialogue, embracing diverse perspectives and encouraging respectful collaboration.
  • Excellence in Craft : Uphold high standards in functionality and design, committing to quality and impactful solutions.

Perks and Benefits

  • Remote‑First Work Environment : Enjoy the flexibility to work from anywhere, with a remote‑first setup that supports work‑life balance and productivity.
  • Competitive Salary : We offer a competitive salary to recognize and reward your skills and contributions.
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off : Take the time you need with an unlimited PTO policy, empowering you to recharge and maintain balance.
  • Professional Development : Access resources for growth, including conference passes, online courses, and training programs to support your career advancement.
  • Home Office Stipend : We provide a budget for setting up your home office with high‑quality equipment and tools.
  • Latest Tech Gear : Receive a top‑of‑the‑line laptop and any necessary peripherals to ensure you have the best tools to do your best work.
  • Team Retreats and Virtual Events : Participate in team‑building retreats and regular virtual gatherings to connect with colleagues and strengthen our culture.
  • Parental Leave : We offer paid parental leave to support you and your family during this important time.

O clima em loja é de descontração, mas quando chega a hora da partida, cada craque veste a camisa da sua posição e joga junto dos clientes. Estamos presentes em 26 estados, com 226 lojas próprias espalhadas pelo Brasil. Somos convictos, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas pela força da nossa essência. Somos fazedores, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas com ações práticas. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas a fazerem mais e melhor. title: Sr. Technical Customer Success Analyst
description:
Title: Sr. Customer Support Analyst

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Location: Brazil, Remote

Graphic Communications( a CAI Division) is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries. Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy that Graphic Communications succeeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at https : / / caisoft.com

As a Sr. Customer Support Analyst , you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Customer Success , you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues.

Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability.

Key Responsibilities

Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy.

Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence.

Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact.

Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions.

Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment.

Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance.

Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution.

Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions.

Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details.

Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation.

Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues.

Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases.

Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics.

Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers.

Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity.

Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates.

Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements.

Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required.

Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities

Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front-end issues, and identify JavaScript or API failures.

Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or cURL.

Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers.

Configure and troubleshoot Windows ADFS Servers and perform remote diagnostics via VPN, RDP, or similar tools.

Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries.

Utilize network tracing tools (e.g., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues.

Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues.

Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET-based applications and related components.

Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments.

Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators.

Experience Requirements

Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience.

description:
Ficamos felizes pelo seu interesse em participar da nossa equipe de colaboradores, que já soma aproximadamente 5.500 funcionários.

Antes de sabermos mais sobre suas características profissionais, convidamos você a conhecer um pouco da história da Santa Casa da

Bahia, instituição filantrópica que se propõe ao objetivo de ajudar aos mais necessitados.

Foi no ano de 1549, quando Tomé de Sousa ocupava o posto de governador-geral do Brasil, que foi construída uma casa de taipa e palha, no Centro Histórico de Salvador, que por cerca de 200 anos abrigou o Hospital de Caridade, primeiro hospital do Estado da Bahia, sendo o único a prestar assistência aos baianos na época.

Somente em 30 de julho de 1893 foi construído o Hospital Santa Izabel (HSI), no bairro de Nazaré, em Salvador, desativando a antiga unidade de saúde que funcionava no Pelourinho. O prédio do primeiro hospital passou a ser a sede administrativa da Santa Casa da Bahia e, em 2006, se tornou o Museu da Misericórdia.

A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino, pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.

description:
What is Teachable?

Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

About your Team

At Teachable, our Data Team is all about getting things done with minimal overhead. We work closely together, sharing ideas, designing efficient systems, and building a robust data platform that supports the entire organization. Reporting to the Data Engineering Manager, you’ll take the lead on key initiatives, from optimizing our data platform to shaping the future of our events pipeline and ETL processes.

Our data infrastructure is primarily hosted on AWS. We leverage managed Airflow for orchestration, managed Kafka for event collection, Redshift for analytics, and S3 for data lake storage. Working as a Mid-level Analyst, you will partner with Finance to build metrics and data models that facilitate data exploration and business logic integration, supporting the continuous improvement of the data platform.

The Impact You'll Make

In this role, you'll be at the heart of our data strategy, taking ownership of mission‑critical infrastructure that supports teams across the company. You’ll also have the opportunity to make strategic recommendations on how we can evolve our data platform to stay ahead of the curve.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Engineering and Product teams on high‑impact initiatives.
  • Design and implement robust data pipelines using AWS services.
  • Enhance event collection, queueing, and processing mechanisms.
  • Build and refine meaningful alerts with automated corrective actions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues, ensuring system reliability and stability.
  • Architect scalable data products with long‑term vision and efficiency in mind.
  • Identify and resolve complex technical challenges involving system integration, infrastructure, and software bugs.

About You

  • 2‑3+ years of experience in Data Engineering
  • Fluency in English is required
  • Strong knowledge of modern data engineering practices and software engineering principles
  • Solid experience with cloud infrastructure, especially AWS data services
  • Advanced understanding of relational data modeling
  • Strong SQL skills and Python for data wrangling
  • Hands‑on experience with data lake technologies (Delta Lake, Hudi, or Iceberg)
  • Experience working with large‑scale data warehouses (e.g., Redshift)
  • Experience integrating with RESTful APIs and webhooks
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, Git version control, and clean coding standards
  • Exposure to monitoring and incident management tools (e.g., CloudWatch, New Relic, PagerDuty)
  • Collaborative team player who values diversity and cross‑functional collaboration
  • Nice to have:
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
  • Experience building and orchestrating data pipelines using Airflow and Spark

Benefits

This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.

This position will be located remotely in Brazil working with Teachable’s data team based in the United States and Hotmart’s data team in Brazil.

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DE PROJETO : La Fundación AVSI es una organización internacional sin fines de lucro con sede en Italia, que actualmente gestiona 364 proyectos de desarrollo en 42 países. Desde el inicio de sus operaciones en Venezuela en 2023, la organización ha consolidado su presencia en el país mediante la implementación de iniciativas clave en Seguridad Alimentaria, Medios de Vida y Nutrición. Su estrategia de intervención prioriza tres ejes fundamentales : i) Nutrición y Salud, con énfasis en el combate a la desnutrición aguda. ii) Protección, enfocada en la prevención de la Violencia Basada en Género (VBG), la niez y el apoyo a comunidades indígenas. y iii) Movilidad Humana en zonas fronterizas. A través de enfoques técnicos especializados, AVSI trabaja directamente con poblaciones vulnerables, no solo para salvar vidas, sino para fortalecer de manera sostenible las capacidades locales. Este proyecto busca mejorar las condiciones de vida, la resiliencia y las oportunidades de desarrollo de jóvenes indígenas y población en movilidad humana en Santa Elena de Uairén, Bolívar mediante la construcción y equipamiento de un Centro de Formación que actuará como un eje integral de servicios. La intervención combina una estrategia educativa, ofreciendo capacitación técnica en oficios (como carpintería y energías renovables) y rescate de saberes tradicionales (medicina y alimentación) para fomentar la empleabilidad. con una estrategia de protección humanitaria, estableciendo un 'Espacio Seguro' que brinda orientación migratoria, atención psicosocial, prevención de violencia de género y distribución de insumos esenciales, todo ello articulado con una respuesta transfronteriza. DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO : El objetivo de este Término de Referencia es la contratación de un / a Gerente de proyecto quien será responsable de garantizar a nivel estratégico y operativo del Proyecto Semillas de Paz la ejecución, seguimiento, evaluación, gestión del conocimiento y liderazgo del personal en la ciudad de Santa Elena de Uairén, Bolívar. PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO : Para la ejecución del proyecto, el / la gerente de proyecto será responsable de las siguientes actividades : Garantizar la comunicación interinstitucional entre los socios, supervisando todas las actividades y garantizando la alineación con los objetivos del proyecto. Realizar la gestión del ciclo del proyecto de responsabilidad de AVSI Venezuela, con un enfoque integrado a los aspectos relacionados a la implementación y la administración. Realizar la coordinación de las actividades estratégicas y operativas del proyecto. Asegurar que el acuerdo y los proyectos relacionados se realicen dentro del plazo, con el alcance, la calidad y el contenido estipulados Ser punto focal y hacer seguimiento a las labores y cumplimiento de los objetivos de los demás integrantes de la plantilla para el desarrollo del Programa y que estarán a su cargo y supervisión. Elaborar informes técnicos, financieros con apoyo del equipo administrativo y político-institucionales para el donante y el presidente de AVSI Venezuela. Preparar el plan operativo, presupuesto y plan de compras financiero y adquisiciones con soporte del equipo administrativo de proyecto y administrador país para ejecución del mismo. Realizar el seguimiento y evaluación del plan de proyecto y gestión del conocimiento. Afianzar la aplicación del uso de las normas y procedimientos vigentes por AVSI Venezuela en los aspectos administrativos, de adquisiciones y de recursos humanos. Coordinar el trabajo del equipo operativo. y articular actividades con responsables de RRHH, Comunicación y Operaciones. Fijar momentos formativos de los equipos operativos. Coordinar el presupuesto del proyecto de responsabilidad de AVSI Venezuela, acompaando el equipo administrativo-financiero en la ejecución de fondos orientada a resultados. Supervisar la ejecución del componente de infraestructura (diseo, construcción / adecuación del Centro de Formação), velando por el cumplimiento de los cronogramas de obra, calidad de materiales, normativas locales y el manual de compras de AVSI, en coordinación con los contratistas y el equipo de operaciones. Asegurar la correcta adquisición técnica y logística de equipamiento especializado (herramientas de oficios, insumos médicos y kits humanitarios) en una zona de difícil acceso. Desarrollar la gestión del proyecto y proveer apoyo para la toma de decisiones estratégicas del proyecto. Actuar en fuerte sinergia y recibir asistencia del equipo regional de Fundación AVSI.

title: Gerente de Proyecto - AVSI Venezuela
description:
CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DE PROJETO: La Fundación AVSI es una organización internacional sin fines de lucro con sede en Italia, que actualmente gestiona 364 proyectos de desarrollo en 42 países. Desde el inicio de sus operaciones en Venezuela en 2023, la organización ha consolidado su presencia en el país mediante la implementación de iniciativas clave en Seguridad Alimentaria, Medios de Vida y Nutrición. Su estrategia de intervención prioriza tres ejes fundamentales: i) Nutrición y Salud, con énfasis en el combate a la desnutrición aguda; ii) Protección, enfocada en la prevención de la Violencia Basada en Género (VBG), la niñez y el apoyo a comunidades indígenas; y iii) Movilidad Humana en zonas fronterizas. A través de enfoques técnicos especializados, AVSI trabaja directamente con poblaciones vulnerables, no solo para salvar vidas, pero también para fortalecer de manera sostenible las capacidades locales.

Este proyecto busca mejorar las condiciones de vida, la resiliencia y las oportunidades de desarrollo de jóvenes indígenas y población en movilidad humana en Santa Elena de Uairén, Bolívar mediante la construcción y equipamiento de un Centro de Formación que actuará como un eje integral de servicios. La intervención combina una estrategia educativa, ofreciendo capacitación técnica en oficios (como carpintería y energías renovables) y rescate de saberes tradicionales (medicina y alimentación) para fomentar la empleabilidad, con una estrategia de protección humanitaria, estableciendo un "Espacio Seguro" que brinda orientación migratoria, atención psicosocial, prevención de violencia de género y distribución de insumos esenciales, todo ello articulado con una respuesta transfronteriza.

Descripción del cargo

El objetivo de este Término de Referencia es la contratación de un/a Gerente de proyecto quien será responsable de garantizar a nivel estratégico y operativo del Proyecto Semillas de Paz la ejecución, seguimiento, evaluación, gestión del conocimiento y liderazgo del personal en la ciudad de Santa Elena de Uairén, Bolívar.

Responsabilidades y actividades

  • Garantizar la comunicación interinstitucional entre los socios, supervisando todas las actividades y garantizando la alineación con los objetivos del proyecto.
  • Realizar la gestión del ciclo del proyecto de responsabilidad de AVSI Venezuela, con un enfoque integrado a los aspectos relacionados a la implementación y la administración.
  • Realizar la coordinación de las actividades estratégicas y operativas del proyecto.
  • Asegurar que el acuerdo y los relacionados se realicen dentro del plazo, con el alcance, la calidad y el contenido estipulados.
  • Ser punto focal y hacer seguimiento a las labores y cumplimiento de los objetivos de los demás integrantes de la plantilla para el desarrollo del Programa y que estarán a su cargo y supervisión.
  • Elaborar informes técnicos, financieros con apoyo del equipo administrativo y político-institucionales para el donante y el presidente de AVSI Venezuela.
  • Preparar el plan operativo, presupuesto y plan de compras financiero y adquisiciones con soporte del equipo administrativo de proyecto y administrador país para ejecución del mismo.
  • Realizar el seguimiento y evaluación del plan de proyecto y gestión del conocimiento.
  • Afianzar la aplicación del uso de las normas y procedimientos vigentes por AVSI Venezuela en los aspectos administrativos, de adquisiciones y de recursos humanos.
  • Coordinar el trabajo del equipo operativo y articular actividades con responsables de RRHH, Comunicación y Operaciones.
  • Fijar momentos formativos de los equipos operativos.
  • Coordinar el presupuesto del proyecto de responsabilidad de AVSI Venezuela, acompañando el equipo administrativo-financiero en la ejecución de fondos orientada a resultados.
  • Supervisar la ejecución del componente de infraestructura (diseño, construcción/adecuación del Centro de Formación), velando por el cumplimiento de los cronogramas de obra, calidad de materiales, normativas locales y el manual de compras de AVSI, en coordinación con los contratistas y el equipo de operaciones.
  • Asegurar la correcta adquisición técnica y logística de equipamiento especializado (herramientas de oficios, insumos médicos y kits humanitarios) en una zona de difícil acceso.
  • Desarrollar la gestión del proyecto y proveer apoyo para la toma de decisiones estratégicas del proyecto.
  • Actuar en fuerte sinergia y recibir asistencia del equipo regional de Fundación AVSI.

Controls Engineer – Sustaining Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time TARGAN

About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world. This is a hands‑on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering. You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain, and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.

What You’ll Do

Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on‑machine interfaces. Provide real‑time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools. Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices. Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams. Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.

What You Bring

Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics. Solid understanding of electro‑mechanical systems, Ethernet networks, and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.). Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems. Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus. Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field preferred. Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai. 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation; equivalent hands‑on experience considered. Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones. Comfortable working cross‑functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.

Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture. At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting‑edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.

Note: final salary is dependent upon geographical location, experience and level.

  • Agilidade e Adaptabilidade : Capacidade de trabalhar com releases semanais, mantendo a cadência de entrega e a qualidade sem comprometer a estabilidade das versões anteriores.

Process Improvement & Client Advisory

Maintain strong financial integrity, proactively troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with accounting standards.

Tools, Communication & Task Management

Manage tasks using Asana and track time entries in Bizinta with detailed descriptions.

Organize and manage the accounting email inbox to ensure timely and accurate handling of financial documents.

5+ years of accounting experience, US based experience or familiarity required.

Fluency in English (written and spoken).

Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.

US Working hours 9am to 5pm Eastern Standard Time.

title: Técnico de Enfermagem
description:
Responsabilidades

O profissional Técnico de Enfermagem será responsável por desempenhar uma série de atividades essenciais ao cuidado e bem‑vontade dos pacientes. Entre suas principais atribuições, destacam‑se a realização de procedimentos de enfermagem, como administração de medicamentos, supervisão de sinais vitais, curativos e coleta de exames laboratoriais. Além disso, o técnico deverá prestar apoio nas atividades de rotina do setor, colaborando com a equipe de saúde para garantir um ambiente seguro e acolhedor. Isso inclui a organização do ambiente de trabalho, a higienização de materiais e a verificação do funcionamento de equipamentos médicos.

O profissional também será responsável por monitorar o estado de saúde dos pacientes, registrando observações em prontuários e comunicando quaisquer alterações ao enfermeiro responsável. É importante que o técnico de enfermagem mantenha uma boa comunicação com os pacientes e seus familiares, esclarecendo dúvidas e orientando sobre cuidados pós‑alta ou tratamento.

O trabalho em equipe será fundamental, pois o técnico atuará em conjunto com enfermeiros, médicos e outros profissionais de saúde, participando de reuniões e treinamentos contínuos para atualização e aprimoramento das práticas de enfermagem. Além de seguir protocolos e normas de segurança e higiene, o técnico deverá lidar com situações de emergência, estando preparado para atuar de forma rápida e eficiente.

O profissional deve demonstrar empatia, ética e compromisso com a qualidade do atendimento, buscando sempre o melhor para os pacientes sob seus cuidados. Portanto, o candidato ideal deve possuir formação técnica em enfermagem, registro ativo no conselho de classe e habilidades interpessoais que facilitem a interação com a equipe e os pacientes.

description:
Sobre a Santa Casa da Bahia

Ficamos felizes pelo seu interesse em participar da nossa equipe de colaboradores, que já soma aproximadamente 5.500 funcionários.

Antes de sabermos mais sobre suas características profissionais, convidamos você a conhecer um pouco da história da Santa Casa da

Bahia, instituição filantrópica que se propõe ao objetivo de ajudar aos mais necessitados.

Foi no ano de 1549, quando Tomé de Sousa ocupava o posto de governador-geral do Brasil, que foi construída uma casa de taipa e palha, no Centro Histórico de Salvador, que por cerca de 200 anos abrigou o Hospital de Caridade, primeiro hospital do Estado da Bahia, sendo o único a prestar assistência aos baianos na época.

Somente em 30 de julho de 1893 foi construído o Hospital Santa Izabel (HSI), no bairro de Nazaré, em Salvador, desativando a antiga unidade de saúde que funcionava no Pelourinho. O prédio do primeiro hospital passou a ser a sede administrativa da Santa Casa da Bahia e, em 2006, se tornou o Museu da Misericórdia.

A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino, pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.

  • A Santa Casa da Bahia NÃO solicita valores para nenhuma situação que envolva oportunidade de emprego, tampouco solicita PIX para realização de cursos para vagas de emprego ou envio de dados pessoais por mensagens. Nosso único meio para recebimento de currículos é através da plataforma Gupy, assim como todas as etapas do processo admissional, ambas situações acessadas com login e senha cadastrados pelo próprio usuário, enquanto cliente da plataforma.*

Fique atento e proteja seus dados!

description:
Descrição do Cargo

Procuramos um Analista Fiscal Jr para integrar nossa equipe em Salvador, BA. Este cargo envolve atividades como análise de documentação fiscal, apuração de tributos, preparação de declarações fiscais e acompanhamento das legislações tributárias vigentes. O profissional precisará assegurar assertividade fiscal ponta a ponta, garantindo que toda a operação da fábrica esteja 100% alinhada às exigências do Lucro Real / Presumido, fortalecendo governança, compliance e tomada de decisão tributária. VAGA 100% PRESENCIAL.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

1. Governança Fiscal e Interface Estratégica com a Contabilidade

  • Ser o ponto focal da contabilidade (interna + terceirizada).
  • Consolidar dados, validar informações e garantir entregas tempestivas.
  • Organizar e mediar alinhamentos com foco em assertividade tributária.

2. Gestão de Obrigações Acessórias

  • Controle e conferência de entregas: SPED Fiscal, SPED Contribuições, EFD-Reinf, DCTF, DIRF, GIA, SINTEGRA e declarações estaduais.
  • Garantir acuracidade das bases enviadas ao escritório contábil.

3. Auditoria e Validação de Documentos

  • Conferência aprofundada de CFOP, CST, NCM, CSOSN, alíquotas interestaduais, DIFAL, ICMS-ST e benefícios fiscais.
  • Revisão fiscal de notas de compra, venda, devolução, bonificação e service entries.

4. Controle de Tributos e Acompanhamento de Apurações

  • Monitorar e validar apuração de ICMS, ICMS-ST, PIS, COFINS, IRPJ, CSLL.
  • Suporte na preparação de informações para a contabilidade, evitando glosas e apontamentos.

5. Gestão de Créditos e Recuperações

  • Mapeamento de créditos fiscais elegíveis: ICMS, ICMS-ST, PIS / COFINS, FCI, créditos de insumos (TJ-MS / RE 607.642).
  • Organização e documentação para aproveitamento mensal.

6. Suporte Institucional às Áreas Internas

  • Orientar compras, vendas e logística sobre impactos fiscais.
  • Auxiliar em precificação, margens e estrutura tributária de produtos.

7. Compliance e Atualização Legal

  • Acompanhar mudanças estaduais e federais com foco em Lucro Real.
  • Reportar riscos, oportunidades e impactos tributários à gestão.

REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS

Formação

  • Técnico ou Superior em Contabilidade, Administração ou áreas afins.

Experiência

  • Experiência prévia no fiscal, obrigatoriamente com exposição a Lucro Real ou Presumido (fase de transição de Presumido para Lucro real).
  • Vivência com operações de alto volume (e-commerce, omnichannel, marketplace) será diferencial.

O QUE OFERECEMOS?

  • Salário compatível com o mercado
  • Vale-transporte e vale-alimentação com desconto em folha.
  • Ambiente em expansão, com espaço real para crescimento.

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 119 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra.

Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo.

Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

A Gurilândia e Land Scholl são escolas Inspired no Brasil.

O amor e o acolhimento são marcas da escola, semeadas pela Tia Vera desde a sua fundação e a Gurilândia e a Land School se baseiam em quatro pilares - Tradição, Inovação, Excelência Acadêmica e Mentalidade Internacional.

Há 60 anos estamos educando gerações em Salvador, e preparando os nossos alunos para os desafios de hoje com uma educação que alia vanguarda e tradição.

Nesse papel você irá auxiliar nas atividades de manutenção preventiva e corretiva nas dependências da escola, garantindo a conservação, segurança e bom funcionamento da infraestrutura física da instituição.

O que você fará :

  • Executar pequenos reparos em estruturas, instalações elétricas, hidráulicas e sanitárias;
  • Realizar serviços de pintura, alvenaria e manutenção de mobiliários;
  • Acompanhar e apoiar serviços de empresas terceirizadas (segurança, limpeza técnica, dedetização, etc.);
  • Realizar vistorias periódicas nas instalações para identificar e prevenir possíveis problemas;
  • Apoiar na montagem e desmontagem de equipamentos e mobiliário em eventos escolares;
  • Cuidar da limpeza e organização de áreas técnicas (salas de manutenção, almoxarifado, etc.);
  • Zelar pela segurança dos alunos e colaboradores durante atividades de manutenção;

Seguir normas de segurança do trabalho e utilizar os EPIs adequados.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada.

Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

O que você precisa ter :

  • Ensino Médio completo;
  • Conhecimentos básicos em elétrica, hidráulica, pintura e alvenaria;
  • Noções de segurança do trabalho;
  • Proatividade, responsabilidade e organização;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e em ambiente escolar.

Será um diferencial se você tiver :

  • Cursos de NR 10 (Segurança em Instalações Elétricas);
  • Cursos profissionalizantes na área de manutenção predial, elétrica, hidráulica, pintura, ou áreas correlatas.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função.

A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização.

Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

description:
Company Overview

If a culture of excellence, innovation and ownership is what you’re searching for, consider putting your experience in motion at Flowserve. As an individual contributor, or as a leader of people, your enterprise mindset will ensure Flowserve’s position as the global standard in comprehensive flow control solutions. Here, your opportunity for professional development and industry leading rewards will be supported by our foundational commitments to the values of people first, integrity and safety. Thinking beyond opportunity and reward, at Flowserve, we are inspired by working together to create extraordinary flow control solutions to make the world better for everyone!

Role Summary

Mechanical Technician is responsible for the dismantle, clean, and inspect processes of all pumps (repair or upgrade) and decoking equipment. In this role the Mechanical Technician will utilize precision inspection equipment to measure dimensions of components and assemblies. The Mechanical Technician will also repair and assemble equipment meeting quality standards, company policies, and on-time delivery.

Responsibilities & Requirements

  • Follow instructions given in pre-job briefings and complete all checklists, routers, and procedures.
  • Clean each part to be reused and documenting the condition of components.
  • Use hand torches and liquid nitrogen when appropriate in the teardown process.
  • Disassemble products to repair or replace defective materials or worn parts and make other repairs, as necessary.
  • Inspect components and assemblies accurately and precisely, and clearly record the results of these inspections.
  • Remove visible dirt, grit oil, grease, and other foreign matter from pump product parts, prior to assembly.
  • Frequently apply primer and finish coatings to the exterior of pump products and parts using spray equipment.
  • Operate various precision measuring tools.
  • Take pictures to document condition and process.
  • Participate and adhere to the implementation and use of appropriate reporting and operating systems, manufacturing, and quality processes.
  • Participate and report quality related problems. Report deviations, ensure creation of Non-Conformity Reports and execute corrective actions identified.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with production planners and customers to discuss the component and pump conditions.
  • Coordinate and interface with sales, operations, engineers, and customers as necessary.
  • Exhibit behavior that encourages team building, decision-making, problem solving and continuous improvement.
  • Experience as a rotating machinery mechanic.
  • Must have personal set of mechanic's tools, micrometers, and roll-around toolbox.
  • Able to stand for long periods and lift objects up to 50 lbs.
  • Must be able to work overtime hours including weekends and holidays.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Preferred Experience / Skills

  • Pump repair experience.
  • Previous experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience with pumps or heavy machinery.
  • HS Diploma / GED and 3-5 years relevant experience.

Flowserve is a world-leading manufacturer and aftermarket service provider of comprehensive flow control systems. Join a company whose people are committed to building a more sustainable future to make the world better for everyone. With 16,000+ employees in 50+ countries, we combine our global reach with local presence. Our team challenges themselves to approach each situation with ingenuity and creativity to help provide our customers with the most innovative flow control products and services. We support 10,000+ customers worldwide, creating products to meet the needs of our customers who are supplying energy, fresh water, pharmaceuticals and other essentials to consumers, businesses and governments globally. We invite you to put your talents and career in motion at Flowserve.

We are seeking an experienced Tech Lead to guide the architecture, delivery, and evolution of modern cloud-based applications. You will collaborate closely with engineering, product, DevOps, and cross‑functional teams to design scalable systems, foster best practices, and ensure high‑quality software delivery.

This position is ideal for a senior engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, mentoring developers, and helping define the long‑term technical vision. You will contribute to architectural decisions, lead code reviews, support production environments, and drive an AI‑first approach by leveraging GenAI tools and methodologies. If you’re passionate about cloud architectures, distributed systems, and modern full‑stack development, this role provides an opportunity to make a significant impact.

  • Support CI/CD pipelines using GitHub and maintain strong DevOps alignment.

Must have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

  • Experience with Generative AI (GenAI) concepts or tools.
  • Hands‑on experience with Azure cloud services and cloud architectures.
  • Strong proficiency with .NET Core 6+, .NET Core ASP.NET, and SQL .
  • Experience managing Kubernetes clusters and containerized workloads.
  • Strong experience with Angular ; exposure to React is a plus.
  • Familiarity with MVC , Entity Framework , and API‑driven development.
  • Solid understanding of SDLC and Agile methodologies.
  • Strong background in unit testing, debugging, and production support .
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across teams.
  • Experience with Git/GitHub and CI pipelines.
  • Experience with Kafka or event‑driven architectures.
  • Exposure to microservices or distributed system design.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure‑as‑code or DevOps tooling.
  • Experience mentoring or managing engineering teams.

This is a hands on execution role focused on speed, volume, and performance. You will not be responsible for strategy, branding, or long term planning. Your job is to generate, edit, and ship large volumes of ad creatives that are tested and judged purely by results.

  • Dislike rapid iteration and frequent kills
  • Need constant validation or subjective feedback

Success Metrics

  4. Suporte Administrativo e Contábil

    • Integrar informações financeiras com o setor contábil / fiscal.
    • Auxiliar na parametrização e atualização de centros de custo e planos de contas no Sienge.
    • Apoiar no controle de contratos, adiantamentos e reembolsos.

description:
Agente de higienização - Higienização IBR

Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Há 87 anos, a Fundação José Silveira mantém o olhar voltado para o futuro, reinventando suas práticas em um mundo imprevisível, sem perder de vista suas raízes sólidas naquilo que é a origem do propósito: cuidar da saúde e melhorar a qualidade de vida das pessoas.

Com isso, buscamos pessoas conectadas ao novo que venham contribuir com o constante crescimento e a perpetuação do nosso legado.

Junte-se ao nosso propósito!

  • Efetuar serviços de limpeza e desinfecção de equipamentos, artigos e das superfícies fixas e móveis, segundo programação e procedimentos definidos;
  • Realizar a limpeza e desinfecção de superfícies fixas e móveis, equipamentos e utensílios, segundo procedimentos, materiais e produtos adequados a cada caso;
  • Acondicionar e coletar os resíduos (comuns, infectantes ou especiais) gerados pelos usuários dos escritórios e demais áreas do hospital, dando-lhes o destino adequado, conforme normas preestabelecidas;
  • Suprir os lavatórios, sanitários e outras instalações quando for o caso, de sacos coletores de resíduos, papel toalha e higiênico e sabão para lavagem das mãos;
  • Informar sobre a identificação de vazamentos, infiltrações, lâmpadas queimadas, descolagens de revestimentos e anormalidades afins, observados no decorrer dos trabalhos, para as providências necessárias;
  • Realizar a limpeza e desinfecção localizada em superfície com presença de matéria orgânica;
  • Apoiar atividades e rotinas de apoio com Higienização em eventos externos (feiras, mutirões de saúde e demais eventos festivos) celebrados nas instalações do IBR e /ou demais instalações da FJS;
  • Recolher dos setores das unidades roupas, compressas hospitalares e campos cirúrgicos utilizados, encaminhando-os segundo procedimentos definidos para a lavanderia.
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Desejável experiência na área de higienização;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em regime de escala: SD02, M011, MT12, M 053,M054, M005.

Plano de saúde e odontológico;

Clube de vantagens do colaborador;

Clube da saúde para o colaborador

Criada em 21 de fevereiro de 1937 pelo Professor José Silveira, a Fundação José Silveira (FJS) vem ampliando sua obra em um processo de crescimento sustentável, firmado no planejamento estratégico e foco nos melhores resultados. Instituição filantrópica sem fins lucrativos, a Fundação José Silveira atende principalmente a população mais desassistida, com qualidade nos serviços prestados.

É o que demonstra o trabalho de referência das nossas unidades em áreas como combate à tuberculose, assistência neonatal, parto humanizado, tratamento do câncer de mama e reabilitação de pacientes com deficiências neuropsicomotoras, intelectuais e autismo. Por ano, são mais de 1,2 milhão de atendimentos realizados. A FJS promove, ainda, ações de prevenção e promoção da saúde e socioambientais voltadas às comunidades de Salvador e de municípios do interior da Bahia, contribuindo para a melhoria dos indicadores sociais e de saúde no estado.

title: Ai Creative Operator (Paid Ads)
description:
Role Summary

We are hiring an AI Creative Operator to produce high performing short form video ads using AI tools only.

This is a hands on execution role focused on speed, volume, and performance. You will not be responsible for strategy, branding, or long term planning. Your job is to generate, edit, and ship large volumes of ad creatives that are tested and judged purely by results.

If you enjoy building fast, iterating constantly, and letting data decide what wins, this role is for you.

What You Will Do

  • Create short form video ads for TikTok and Meta using AI tools only
  • Generate high volumes of hooks, variants, and edits daily
  • Recreate and remix winning competitor ads using provided references
  • Use tools like VEED, CapCut, HeyGen, and similar AI video tools

What You Will Not Do

  • You will not define marketing strategy
  • You will not manage ad accounts or budgets
  • You will not appear on camera
  • You will not do brand storytelling or long form creative work
  • You will not guess what works without testing

Tools You Will Use

  • AI video editors such as VEED, CapCut, HeyGen
  • Ad inspiration tools such as Foreplay
  • Internal creative briefs and SOPs
  • Performance dashboards for feedback
  • Experience with these tools is a plus, but the ability to learn fast matters more.

Who This Role Is For

  • Are highly comfortable using modern AI tools
  • Understand TikTok and short form video pacing
  • Can produce many versions of the same idea quickly
  • Do not get emotionally attached to your work
  • Prefer clear instructions and performance based feedback
  • Enjoy repetitive execution with constant improvement
  • You do not need years of marketing experience. Skill and output matter more than background.

Who This Role Is Not For

  • Want to own strategy or creative direction
  • Prefer polished brand work over performance ads
  • Dislike rapid iteration and frequent kills
  • Need constant validation or subjective feedback
  • Want a traditional marketing career path

Success Metrics

  • Number of creatives shipped per week
  • Speed of iteration
  • Percentage of creatives that pass initial testing
  • Cost per install performance versus baseline
  • Opinions do not matter. Results do.

Location

Remote. We welcome applicants globally.

This role is fully async with clear processes and expectations.

How to Apply

Applicants will be asked to complete a short practical task that simulates the real work. Only candidates who demonstrate speed, taste, and execution ability will move forward.

To begin, complete this short work style assessment, we will select and message the best fit candidates.

Junto nossos negócios levam entretenimento, cultura e informação para mais de 12 milhões de pessoas. Primeiro e único de emissora de TV aberta a cobrir todo o Estado.

Empoderamos pessoas e comunidades por meio de conteúdo e notícias que nutrem e movimentam toda a sociedade.

Acreditamos que a pluralidade de vozes, histórias e vivências transforma não só a forma como comunicamos, mas também como construímos um ambiente de trabalho mais justo, representativo e inovador.

Buscamos pessoas com diferentes trajetórias, histórias e perspectivas, pois acreditamos que a pluralidade fortalece nosso propósito e amplia nosso olhar. Valorizamos e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas negras, indígenas, com deficiência, LGBTQIAPN+, de diferentes religiões, origens, idades e identidades.

Descrição da vaga

Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.

Se você preza pela valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação em soluções em tudo o que faz, vem fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.

Vem conferir!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Cumprimentar os clientes de forma cortês e prestativa, ajudando a esclarecer dúvidas, fornecendo informações sobre produtos, incluindo dosagem, uso e possíveis efeitos colaterais.
  • Dispensação de Medicamentos: Dispensar medicamentos prescritos com precisão, seguindo os regulamentos e procedimentos da farmácia. Certificar-se de que os pacientes recebam as orientações adequadas sobre o uso de medicamentos.
  • Vendas e Registro de Vendas: Realizar vendas de produtos de venda livre e registrar as transações com precisão. Processar pagamentos em dinheiro, cartão de crédito ou outros métodos de pagamento aceitos pela farmácia.
  • Gestão de Estoque: Verificar regularmente o estoque de medicamentos e produtos, repor itens conforme necessário e garantir que os produtos estejam dentro do prazo de validade. Manter registros precisos de estoque.
  • Conhecimento de Produtos: Manter-se atualizado sobre os produtos disponíveis na farmácia, incluindo suas características, benefícios e possíveis interações medicamentosas.
  • Atendimento Telefônico: Atender chamadas telefônicas de forma profissional, responder a perguntas dos clientes.
  • Organização: Manter a área de atendimento ao cliente e as prateleiras organizadas. Garantir que produtos perigosos sejam armazenados adequadamente e de acordo com as normas de segurança.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Conhecimento em Informática Básica;
  • Desejável experiência como operador de caixa e atendimento ao cliente.
  • Disponibilidade de trabalhar em escala 6x1.

Que Pode Ser Um Diferencial

  • Experiência como operador de caixa e atendimento ao cliente.

Informações adicionais

Para aumentar sua chance de ser selecionado para esta vaga, preencha o formulário no link e concorra a uma vaga no Curso gratuito de Operador de Loja, desenvolvido pela Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma.

Benefícios

  • Vale-refeição (de acordo com a convenção coletiva);
  • Vale-transporte;
  • Plano de Saúde por elegibilidade por localidade e cargo;
  • Plano Odontológico por adesão;
  • Seguro de vida e Assistência Funeral;
  • Plataforma de terapia online;
  • Programa de Gestantes;
  • Convênios Educacionais com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores e dependentes;
  • Universidade Corporativa Pague Menos com cursos e treinamentos - Up Farma;
  • Desconto Ouro nas Farmácias Pague Menos;
  • Convênio Farmácia, com desconto em folha de pagamento - Epharma;

Não fazemos distinção de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.

VEM SER GIGANTE, VEM TRABALHAR NA REDE DE FARMÁCIAS QUE É DO TAMANHO DO BRASIL

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana , da superação de resultados , do foco no cliente , da sustentabilidade , da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore. Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde . Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .

Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.
